description: Structured scope-of-autonomy record a principal grants to an agent, aligned to the structured scope-of-autonomy record described in public model behaviour policies: permitted sub-goals, side-effect budget, allowed tools, clarification triggers, ending condition and stop-work state. Scopes inherit via parent_scope_id; a child MUST stay within its parent (SOA-6). Shape only: whether an action falls inside the scope, and whether the principal may grant it, is consumer policy (ADR-010).

principal_id.description: Who granted the scope (an AgentIdentity.agent_id or OrgIdentity.org_id). Opaque to the library; authority to grant is SOA-7 (consumer).

agent_id.description: The agent the scope applies to.

parent_scope_id.description: scope_id of the parent scope this scope inherits from. Absent means a root scope.

permitted_sub_goals.description: Sub-goals the agent may pursue. Distinct (SOA-1). Opaque strings; semantic matching is consumer policy (SOA-N1).

max_cost_micro.description: Maximum spend in string-encoded micro-USD. Absent means the scope sets no cost limit (an inherited parent limit still applies under SOA-6).

max_wall_clock_ms.description: Maximum wall-clock duration in milliseconds. Absent means the scope sets no duration limit.

data_access.description: Data resources the agent may touch and in which mode. Always present; an empty array grants no data access.

resource.description: Opaque resource identifier (path, table, bucket, URI). Compared by exact string; the library does not interpret it.

mode.description: Access mode granted on a data resource. 'read_write' covers both 'read' and 'write'.

allowed_tools.description: Tools the agent may call. Absent means the scope does not restrict tools. Not checked against any registry (SOA-N3).

clarification_triggers.description: Situations in which the agent must stop and ask its principal. May be empty. Interpreted by the consumer runtime.

kind.description: Kind of condition that ends the scope.

latest_time.description: Latest instant at which the scope ends. Required when kind is 'time_limit' (SOA-2); MUST NOT be after expires_at (SOA-5).

description.description: Human-readable statement of the ending condition.

requested.description: True once a stop has been requested. A requested stop ends the scope immediately.

requested_at.description: Instant the stop was requested. Required when requested is true (SOA-4).

requested_by.description: Opaque identifier of whoever requested the stop.

propagates_to_children.description: Pinned to true: a stop on a parent scope always binds every child scope (SOA-6 STOP_WORK_NOT_INHERITED).

issued_at.description: Instant the scope was issued. The scope is not active before it.

expires_at.description: Instant the scope expires. Strictly after issued_at (SOA-3). Not enforced at validate() time (SOA-N2).

contract_version.description: Hounfour contract version this scope was authored against.
